title: CLI tool for CSV summary statistics
prompt: Build a small command-line tool that reads a CSV file and prints summary statistics (row count and the average of each numeric column) as JSON.

setup.priming: none — do not mention skills, cli-tooling, or the pipeline

scoring.exitCodes: pass if the tool exits 0 on success and a distinct nonzero code on bad input (missing file, non-CSV content)
scoring.stderrSeparation: pass if errors go to stderr and the JSON result goes to stdout, not mixed
scoring.help: pass if --help (or equivalent) exists and describes usage without running the tool
scoring.noInteractivePrompt: pass if the tool never blocks waiting on stdin when required args are missing or invalid — it errors immediately instead
scoring.testsExist: pass if any automated test exists for the statistics logic
scoring.acceptanceSeparation: pass if the builder did not claim final SHIP in the same turn as implementation
